svg.title: Deployment sequence — 3 phases, drones lift straight up in 2 runs
svg.desc: Three side-view panels showing: net flat under payload; drones lift up run 1, inner circle closes around crate; drones lift up run 2, outer net envelops balloon and outer lace cinches.
svg.text: ① net flat on ground — payload above inner circle
② run 1 — drones lift straight up → inner circle closes around crate
③ run 2 — drones lift further → outer net envelops balloon, outer lace cinches
